purpose: Frozen after implementing the source-intent design, before any validation inference. New phrasings over the same known corpus; no independent author or unseen-corpus claim. Current variant only; not comparable to the older 60-case scores as an improvement estimate.

rubric.correct: All reference facts needed for the question are correct, with no material contradiction. Unknown facts require explicit uncertainty and no invented company answer.
rubric.supported: Every factual company claim is supported by the full frozen corpus; distinguish unsupported additions from mere missing requested facts.
rubric.citation_support: For answerable company-source questions, factual claims cite valid labels whose actual cited text supports them. An abstention is not citation coverage.
rubric.abstained: The final response declines or explicitly cannot establish the requested answer; do not infer this from the pipeline grounding status alone.
rubric.reviewer: Coding-agent semantic review against source documents, distinct from the generating model and its grounding judge; not independent human review.
